task.title: How to Enroll in DUO Multifactor Authentication
task.shortdesc: Enrolling in DUO MFA at NC State adds an extra layer of protection for your NC State unity ID.

taskbody.prereq: You must have at least one device (mobile phone, tablet or security key) to begin.

step.cmd: Go to the Duo Enrollment and Device Management page
Log in with your NC State Unity ID and password.
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the enrollment process.
NC State encourages use of the Duo mobile app as your primary authentication method for consistent reliability.
